inlines.v: FUN'NEL, noun 1. A passage or avenue for a fluid or flowing substance, particularly the shaft or hollow channel of a chimney through which smoke ascends. 2. A vessel for conveying fluids into close vessels; a kind of hollow cone with a pipe; a tunnel.
